query: New student here, could you please provide details about the tuition fee structure at BRAC University?
reference_answer: For students enrolled in the Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) program at BRAC University, the tuition fee structure includes a one-time, non-refundable admission fee of BDT 30,800. Each course within the CSE program costs BDT 22,500. Additionally, students are required to pay a semester fee of BDT 11,500, which covers various facilities such as IT services and library access. There is also a one-time library membership fee of BDT 2,500. This fee structure is designed to support the comprehensive education provided in the CSE program, ensuring access to advanced resources and facilities?

query: I looked around the site but couldn't find it — how to submit report after a club event?
reference_answer:
After conducting an online event or offline event, a report on the event with details needs to be submitted to <student_org@bracu.ac.bd> within 7 working days. Without the report, future proposals will not be accepted and approved.

• The report must contain a minimum of 500 words to a maximum of 1000 words with detailed activities, discussion, social impact, and outcome. If you get any media, coverage please provide the link.

• The social media data must be included in the report such as the number of attendees, likes, shares, views, and comments. For the best accuracy please collect this information immediately after the event is completed.

• After receiving and reviewing the appropriate report, we will complete the event or online program. Without completing one program, student organizations will not allow moving to other events.

query: Can you tell me what the eligibility criteria for receiving financial aid are?
